text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At first glance, Matikanetannhauser just looks like your ordinary Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite this, all of her friends vouch for her unwavering optimism when faced with situations that would cause most Umamusume to get cold feet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Director Akikawa points out to an oblivious Matikanetannhauser that her optimism is her greatest strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing the director's words, she becomes filled with newfound energy and motivation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, my days chasing victory with the ordinary, slightly clumsy, but most importantly, hardworking Matikanetannhauser begin.
